svg.title: J for Jali and Screen Pattern Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A bold J fills with an Indian-inspired eight-point geometric jali repeat, then introduces motif, pattern and screen concepts including an arched decorative screen. This is an illustrative design animation, not a fabrication drawing.
svg.metadata: 16:9; 1920 by 1080; 6.5-second loop; reimagines the palette of 10_J_jingles.png for jali pattern design; no external assets.

g.text: GEOMETRY, LIGHT AND SPACE IN HARMONY.
